title: Gemma 4 instruct models collapse into tight repetition loops on long enumerations
fix: Documented model-level behaviour, reproduced across Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and Workers AI. Short term: cap enumeration length, use DRY / mild repeat controls. Long term: repetition entry in the surgery playbook.

title: Gemma 4 loops only under format=json / JSON schema on Ollama
fix: The grammar admits any string content, so degenerate tokens are not rejected. Relax the constraint (validate JSON afterwards) or post-process; penalties do not help.

title: Ollama's newer runner ignores repeat / frequency / presence penalties
fix: The penalty you set has no effect. Use temperature and min_p, keep Ollama updated, or run the model in llama.cpp to apply penalties.

title: vLLM Gemma 4 tool-call parser leaks raw tokens into the stream
fix: Raw <|" and "|> tokens reach the client instead of parsed tool_calls. Upgrade vLLM past the fix or use the non-streaming path.

title: Early Gemma 4 GGUF uploads shipped a broken chat template
fix: Re-download the corrected GGUF upload (compare with `wsr config --upstream <repo>`).

title: llama.cpp Vulkan backend emits 'GGGG' for some models
fix: Switch away from Vulkan (CUDA / ROCm / CPU) and compare; it is the backend, not the file.

title: Llama 3 ends turns with <|eot_id|> but older configs stop only on <|end_of_text|>
fix: List both ids in generation_config.json eos_token_id (128001 and 128009) or pass <|eot_id|> as a stop token.

title: llama-server applies no repeat penalty or DRY by default
fix: Enable DRY explicitly (dry_multiplier 0.8) and a mild repeat penalty (1.05).
